analysis.summary: Lloyds Metals and Energy Limited reported record operational and financial performances for FY26, with consolidated revenues crossing INR17,000 crores and standalone profit exceeding INR3,100 crores. Management highlighted major volume expansions in iron ore, full-capacity utilization of the first pellet plant within four months, and the commissioning of the second pellet plant taking total capacity to 8 million tons. The company also announced strategic diversification into critical minerals via a copper plant commissioning and an acquisition in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Chemaf). For FY27, management provided explicit operational guidance expecting higher iron ore production, increased pellet output, and further steelmaking integration. The provided document from BSE Ltd.

guidance.claim: The company guided for FY27 iron ore production of 26 million tons and dispatches of 27 million tons.
guidance.quote: Our FY '27 guidance reflects the next change in our scale, iron ore production at 26 million tons, dispatches of 27 million tons, pellet of 7.75 million to 8 million tons, DRI at 825,000 tons and a formal entry into steelmaking with wire rod mill production at around 150,000 tons.

guidance.claim: Annual cost savings are expected to surpass INR2,000 crores per annum by March 2028 as logistics and sustainability initiatives mature.
guidance.quote: We expect annual cost savings to surpass INR2,000 crores per annum as all logistics and sustainability initiatives are maturing by March '28.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that steel markets and iron ore demand remain as strong as ever, particularly in the Indian market.
demand_outlook.quote: The steel markets and therefore, iron ore are as strong as ever, especially in Indian market.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has invested INR13,500 crores in capex over the last 4 years.
capex_expansion.quote: Konsari, in Gadchiroli, we have completed the 2 pellet plants reaching capacity of 8 million tons, making us the largest merchant pellet player by far.

capex_expansion.claim: The second pellet plant was commissioned in May 2026, taking total pellet capacity to 8 million tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: I'm also pleased to share that the second pellet plant was commissioned in May 2026. This takes our total pellet capacity to 8 million tons per annum and positions us strongly for FY27 volume growth.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin held steady at approximately 34% across the last two quarters.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin has held steady at approximately 34% across both the last 2 quarters, demonstrating structural cost efficiency and not one-off gains.

margins_costs.claim: Full year FY26 EBITDA margin stood at 33.77%, up 418 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin for the full year stood at 33.77%, up 418 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Logistics cost for most iron ore output is expected to reduce by more than INR500 a ton via the planned 195-kilometer pipeline.
margins_costs.quote: This pipeline will reduce logistic cost for most of the iron ore output by us by more than INR500 a ton and is in advanced planning stage.

orders_capacity.claim: Iron ore production scaled from 10 million to 22 million tons, representing a 120% growth in a single year.
orders_capacity.quote: On operations, our iron ore scaled from 10 million to 22 million tons, which is a 120% growth in a single year.

orders_capacity.claim: The first pellet plant reached 100% capacity utilization within 4 months of commissioning.
orders_capacity.quote: The pellet plant commissioned at the fag end of Q2 reached 100% capacity utilization within just 4 months, 3 million tons in 9 months, a ramp-up that very few plants anywhere in the country have achieved.

orders_capacity.claim: Total pellet capacity stands at 8 million tons per annum following the commissioning of the second pellet plant.
orders_capacity.quote: This takes our total pellet capacity to 8 million tons per annum and positions us strongly for FY27 volume growth.

capital_allocation.claim: Standalone net debt as of March 31, 2026, stood at INR3,901 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Stand-alone net debt as on 31st March 2026 stands at INR3,901 crores, a manageable level given our EBITDA generation.

management_commitments.claim: Annual cost savings are expected to surpass INR2,000 crores per annum as logistics and sustainability initiatives mature by March 2028.
management_commitments.quote: We expect annual cost savings to surpass INR2,000 crores per annum as all logistics and sustainability initiatives are maturing by March '28.

management_commitments.claim: Cobalt capacity is expected to scale to approximately 20,000 tons in the two operating plants over the next 3 to 5 years.
management_commitments.quote: Cobalt capacity is expected to scale to approximately 20,000 tons in the 2 operating plants.

management_commitments.claim: The company will achieve 100,000 tons of copper over the next 3 to 5 years from both CHEMAF and Surya.
management_commitments.quote: Along with this, we will be achieving 100,000 tons of copper over the next 3 to 5 years from both CHEMAF and Surya.

management_commitments.claim: Management outlined plans to increase mining output to over 26 MTPA, develop 45 MTPA beneficiation capacity, and expand pellet production to 12 MTPA.
management_commitments.quote: We plan to increase mining output to over 26 MTPA while developing 45 MTPA beneficiation capacity and expanding pellet production to 12 MTPA.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
